name: Aider
official_status_notes: Open-source terminal pair-programming tool; supports many cloud and local LLMs; repo map; git auto-commit; linter/test loop (verified Sep 2026).
pricing_summary: Free, open source, BYOK (model API costs only).
best_for: Terminal-first editing with tight git integration and many model options.
strengths: Repo map, automatic git commits, linter/test integration, voice control, model flexibility.
weaknesses: Pair-programming (edit) focus rather than full autonomy; you drive the loop.
